title: Curated candidate schema contract
summary: The latest-main manual publish session 019f0314-d59a-7f31-87fe-f55967f334b0 reached report_write and failed candidate-pool validation after curated builder candidates were tagged with curated_first_party. The marker was already produced and consumed by discovery/draft code, but the candidate pool schema still rejected it as an additional property. This iteration adds a focused regression test and declares curated_first_party as a boolean candidate property while keeping additionalProperties false.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "candidate pool schema accepts curated first-party builder candidates" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: When a durable marker is added to generated candidate data, the persisted candidate-pool schema must be updated in the same slice.
lessons.evidence: report_write uses validateCandidatePool before writing reports-data; curated_first_party reached candidates 70-72 and was rejected as an undeclared additional property.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep generated candidate fields schema-bound and add focused candidate-pool validation tests for every new persisted marker.

followups.action: After this branch is merged, rerun the manual daily task and verify it advances past report_write into build, page-check, validation, and publish/dry-run stages.
